name: 17260-rewrite-qwen8b-1gpu
workload: news-article copy-edit, 200 CNN/DailyMail articles, ~893 prompt tokens, 512 output tokens pinned per request
purpose: A newsroom copy-editing service rewriting full articles for concurrent editors with an 8B model on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only: an indented block is skipped by the reader that builds the launch
# line, and the engine would start without that argument at rc=0.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tp-size: 1
speculative-algorithm: NGRAM
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 12
attention-backend: flashinfer
max-running-requests: 48
mem-fraction-static: 0.8
